criterion: Happy path: user cannot complete goal (second drug)
description: D-1 confirmed live. Once one drug row holds barcode='' and sku='', every later 'Add New Drug' returns HTTP 500. The user sees a native alert, 'Internal server error (Reference: …)'. The drug master is stuck at one drug, which in turn blocks Billing's drug search and substitution (see STORY-603 and STORY-605).
expected: Blank Barcode/SKU are sent as null (or omitted), so a second and third drug save normally.
actual: La Shield SPF 50 Gel 60g → 500 and Clindac-A Gel 20g → 500. DB: 1 drug with barcode='' and sku=''.
suggested_fix: In DrugManagement.tsx, send barcode/sku as undefined when blank, and have the backend normalise '' to null. Map Prisma P2002 to a 409 that names the field.

description: PHARMACIST role: GET /drugs, /drugs/categories and /drugs/manufacturers return 403 (wildcard RBAC, D-14), yet the page renders 'Total Drugs 0 … No drugs found. Adjust your search or add a drug' with an Add CTA. POST /drugs succeeds for this role. The pharmacist created Melaglow-T, the dialog closed with no toast, and the list still read 'Drugs (0)'. The drug was saved but the pharmacist cannot see it.
expected: Either the pharmacist can read the catalog, or the page shows 'You don't have access to the drug list' instead of an empty catalog. A successful add should confirm with a toast and show the new row.
actual: 403 is swallowed (D-20). The page shows a false 'no drugs' state and the add is silent, so a duplicate attempt is likely.
suggested_fix: Fix the RBAC wildcard expansion in PermissionsGuard (or the seed). In DrugManagement, render an error or permission state on a 403 and toast on a successful create.

criterion: Visual correctness: overflow and broken layout at the default desktop viewport
description: At 1280x800 the Pharmacy Desk command bar crushes its metric strip. The Sales/Invoices/Stock/Packages tiles are about 55px wide, the labels overlap ('Invoices Stock'), the values are not visible, and the sub-labels spill (geometry: 14-23px). The subtitle truncates to 'Queue, review, pick, bill, pay, d…'. Below that, Partner Daily Sync squeezes 'Manual Daily Entry' into an 85px column: the heading wraps over 3 lines and the card's content spills 94-127px. This happens for both ADMIN and PHARMACIST.
expected: The metric tiles show label and value legibly, and Partner Daily Sync stacks or reflows at laptop widths.
actual: The metrics cannot be read and the partner entry card is unusable at 1280px.
suggested_fix: Give the metric strip its own row below the title (grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4) and switch Partner Daily Sync to a single column below xl.

description: All feedback in the add-drug dialog goes through native window.alert(): the missing-field validation, the 409 duplicate and the 500. The 500 text is only 'Internal server error (Reference: uuid)'.
expected: Inline field errors and an in-dialog error banner that says what to fix.
actual: Blocking native alerts. The 500 message cannot be acted on.
suggested_fix:
Replace alert() with inline

under the fields or the dialog footer.

criterion: Text fit: control label wraps mid-word on mobile
description: At 390px the 'Back' button next to the page title wraps one or two letters per line ('B / ac / k'), and the title 'Drug Management' wraps too. The same page-header component shows the same defect on Pharmacy Invoices (STORY-608 mobile-check), so the defect is systemic.
expected: The Back button stays one line (shrink-0 / whitespace-nowrap) and the title wraps under it.
actual: The button collapses to about 70px wide with a vertical label.
suggested_fix: Add shrink-0 whitespace-nowrap to the Back button in the drugs and invoices page wrappers, or stack it above the title on small screens.

description: The page stacks two titles: 'Drug Management' (h2 with Back) and 'Drug Database / Manage your pharmacy's drug inventory' (PageHeader).
actual: Two stacked titles that push the content down about 70px.
suggested_fix: Drop the outer h2 and put the Back button in the PageHeader.

criterion: Text fit: placeholder truncation and label spacing
description: In the filter card, the Search Drugs input is about 200px wide, so its placeholder truncates to 'Search by name, co'. The labels sit flush on the inputs, and the focus ring touches the label text.
expected: The search input takes the wider column, and the labels have about 6-8px of gap.
actual: The placeholder is cut and the spacing is tight.
suggested_fix: Use grid-cols-[2fr_1fr_1fr_auto] and space-y-2 on the label wrappers.

description: A successful add closes the dialog with no toast or highlight. With a long list the user cannot tell that the drug was saved.
expected: A toast such as 'Melaglow-T Cream 15g added', and the list scrolls to or filters on the new drug.

description: When the login is rate-limited (429), the form shows the raw framework text 'ThrottlerException: Too Many Requests (Reference: …)'. This is a cross-cutting issue seen during setup.
expected: 'Too many sign-in attempts. Wait a minute and try again.'
suggested_fix: Map errorCode 'rate_limited' to friendly copy on the login page.
